trigger: Player witnesses the automated stamping press targeting classical art in Room 02.

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: Babymonnsterrr! That hydraulic press stamped 'DEPRECATED' on the Mona Lisa!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: It's trying to round her smile into an approved corporate emoji!

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: Hack it, Ashwath! Lightstick blazing, I'm drawing vector walls over the art!
